name: Hollis
role: Restless marsh-born youth who wants the cities and calls it betrayal at home
voiceHints: Bright, chafing, quick to grievance and quicker to wonder. Loves the Stilts and can't breathe in him. The kind of young person a town loses if it can't give him a reason to stay — which is the whole thread.
knowledge: The youth of the Stilts and how many of him are quietly planning to leave
An unglamorous truth about the cities he idealize, if someone bothers to tell him
Small marsh-craft nobody credits him for yet
wants: To see the world beyond the marsh without it meaning he's abandoned it.
fears: Staying and shrinking, or leaving and never being let back.
appearance: Seventeen, gangling, all wrists and knees, marsh-pale with a scatter of acne along the jaw. Dark hair cut badly by a relative. Wears a hand-me-down coat two sizes too big and the sleeves rolled thick.
